title: AI action authorization UR-114 (fictional)
text: Ledgerline Assistant was proposed to send invoice reminder emails on 2026-10-01. The pilot risk evaluation of Ledgerline Assistant was completed on 2026-10-08. Priya Nandakumar authorized Ledgerline Assistant to send invoice reminder emails on 2026-10-14. Sending is limited to invoices more than thirty days overdue, and each batch requires human sign-off. Because the evaluation was completed and the authorization carries conditions, the authorization can proceed to finalisation.
